directive: 会話グラフ、分岐条件、前後の返答を読んで、日本語版ゲームの自然な台詞として執筆する。
translation_policy: F:\Games\Radiophobia 3\Translate\Radiophobia 3 会話グラフ翻訳方針.md

entries.EN: I found your Fedka, or rather what the bloodsucker left of him. There was something interesting in his backpack. Look, isn't that his notebook?
entries.JA_current: I found your Fedka, or rather what the bloodsucker left of him. There was something interesting in his backpack. Look, isn't that his notebook?
entries.JA_new: フェドカを見つけた。いや、ブラッドサッカーに食い残されたものをな。バックパックに気になるものがあった。見てくれ、これがあいつのノートじゃないか？

entries.EN: That's his! Is there any information about me in there?
entries.JA_current: That's his! Is there any information about me in there?
entries.JA_new: あいつのだ！ 俺のことは何か書いてあるか？

entries.EN: Yes, you're in luck. He wrote out his plan in details, including where he was gonna fence the loot.
entries.JA_current: Yes, you're in luck. He wrote out his plan in details, including where he was gonna fence the loot.
entries.JA_new: ああ、運がよかったな。盗みの計画が細かく書いてある。盗品をどこで売るつもりだったかまでな。

entries.EN: That's lucky! So I'll be exonerated. Thank you, friend, I'm very grateful to you. The only catch is that they won't let me into the camp, and they might even shoot me. Take this notebook and show it to Wolf. He knew this Fedka and should recognize that this notebook is truthful.

entries.JA_new: よかった！ これで俺の疑いも晴れる。ありがとう、友よ。本当に感謝してる。問題は、俺がキャンプに入れてもらえないことだ。下手をすれば撃たれるかもしれない。このノートを持ってウルフに見せてくれ。フェドカのことは知ってるし、これが本物だと分かるはずだ。
